notes: Lockout is 5 failures per username / 50 per IP in 15 minutes, held in memory — a server restart clears it. The block is checked BEFORE the password, so a correct password still fails while locked.
Enrolment exists ONLY in the admin panel. No clinic role can enable it. SUSPECTED DEFECT: backup codes are 11 characters but the code field caps at 6, so the documented recovery path cannot be used.
Tokens are created correctly, last 60 minutes and are single-use. SMTP is NOT configured in this environment, so no email is sent — read the token from the database to test the reset screen.
The forced first-login screen does NOT ask for the old password; the Settings card does. Wording differs between them. Only rule is a minimum of 8 characters — no complexity requirement exists.

Set company-wide by the super admin. Off by default. Takes up to a minute to apply and the observed cut-off can run past the nominal window. The session row is deleted, so disabling the timeout cannot revive it.

Effective access = clinic capability INTERSECT user permission, with feature gating as a separate third check. Note the opposite senses of empty: clinic capabilities NULL means all allowed; a user's empty permission array means nothing allowed.
A denied page visit is a silent redirect to /clinic — no 403 page, no message. Testers routinely report this as 'the link does nothing'. Worth raising as a usability gap, not a security one.

feature: Create, edit, search, delete, restore, export
notes: Single full-name field — there is NO first/last name split. AGE is entered, not date of birth. MRN is assigned automatically and never typed. Name and phone are the only required fields.
Two patients may share a phone number with no warning — deliberate, since families share a number. Confirm with the product owner whether a soft duplicate warning is wanted.

feature: Book, edit, reschedule, cancel, status flow, queue
notes: Status advance labels are Arrived, then Call in, then Complete. Completion is what turns the bill into revenue. Queue numbers are stable across cancellations.
Leave, working hours and the daily cap are all enforced server-side. 'Custom time' relaxes the WORKING HOURS rule only — it overrides neither leave nor the cap.
A pending discount is treated as ZERO on the bill until approved. This is the workflow working — do not raise it as a calculation error. Percentages are capped at 100.
Stopping the recording AUTO-SUBMITS. There is no pause, no cancel, no re-record, no timer and no playback before submitting.
Microphone only — there is no file picker and no accept list anywhere in the UI. The API would accept a posted file, so upload cases must be driven through an API client, not the interface.

feature: Transcription to a structured clinical note
notes: Needs TWO vendors: OpenAI Whisper to transcribe and Anthropic Claude to structure. The Anthropic key is set; the OpenAI key is NOT, so every run currently fails at the Whisper step. Add OPENAI_API_KEY and re-run the amber rows.
A failed run keeps its recording and offers 'Try again', which reuses the stored audio. The stall sweep fails runs stuck over 15 minutes but deliberately does not re-run them.
The raw transcript is read-only and visible in exactly one place — a collapsed section on the review screen, and never again after approval. Only the structured NOTE is editable.

feature: Transcript versioning, speaker labels, timestamps, export, re-transcribe
notes: None of these exist. There is no version history, no diarisation, no timings, no transcript download, and no way to re-transcribe a run that already succeeded. Do not write cases for them.
NO role can retrieve the recording through the application — no player and no route exist. Audio also survives discarding the run. Worth confirming both as intended with the product owner.

Drafts are author-only, enforced in the query and not just the UI. The one exception covers a draft whose author can no longer sign in, shown in a separate 'Left by a former colleague' card. Reactivating the author returns the draft to them.
There is NO date field on the payment form — payments are stamped at the moment of entry and cannot be back-dated. Overpayment becomes patient credit rather than being refused.
The receipt number is allocated automatically on the first payment; the invoice number only when explicitly requested. Both reset each January and a voided invoice keeps its number.
A reconciliation over existing cash records, not a second ledger. 'Paid for something' writes a REAL expense that hits the P&L; banking or topping up only moves money between pockets and must not.

feature: Sales, Profit & Loss, Receivables, Discounts, Day book
notes: Sales screens need the 'sales' feature; Expenses, Petty cash and P&L need 'finance'. A user may hold the permission and still not see the page. Record each screen's DEFAULT period — missing data is usually a default window.

feature: Clinics, team, subscriptions, announcements, impersonation, trash, import
notes: A separate company panel. Sub-roles hold different capability sets — test a scoped one such as Support, not only the owner. The permanent purge here is the ONLY true deletion in the product.
HIGH VALUE TEST. Raising a clinic's price must not re-price months already paid. If a price rise turns a good payer into an apparent debtor, that is a serious billing defect.

feature: Create, edit, suspend, deactivate, delete, password reset, permission grid
notes: Editing a clinic admin's permission grid has no effect — they hold everything by short-circuit. The clinic can never be left with no active admin.

feature: Outbound confirmations, reminders, recalls, inbound self-service
notes: WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_TOKEN IS set, so the inbound webhook, patient self-service (reschedule, cancel, self-booking), idempotency and attribution are all testable now. Outbound DELIVERY is not — no AiSensy or Cloud API credentials. Messages are still recorded before sending, so the log and the triggers can be verified. The Meta verification and signature cases need WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN and WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET and are marked blocked.

feature: Recalls, reminders, reconciliation, scribe recovery, retention
notes: CRON_SECRET IS set, so every job can be invoked manually and fully tested: auth, idempotency, and each job effect. What is NOT done is INSTALLING the schedule on the server (TC-CRON-014). A job that is never invoked raises no error, so an uninstalled crontab is indistinguishable from a healthy one from inside the app — recalls, reminders and the nightly reconciliation all fail silently. Reconcile matters most: the payment path records money first and derives the ledger after, on the basis that drift is repaired nightly.
Nothing in the clinic panel is ever hard-deleted. Restoring a parent brings back the children its deletion hid, as one batch.

feature: Loading, empty, error states, toasts, dark mode
notes: Confirm a repeated identical save still announces itself — a confirmation that appears only on the first save is a known class of bug in this codebase.
An unknown URL inside /clinic or /admin renders a not-found page but returns HTTP 200, as a deliberate consequence of the security-policy design. Do not raise the status code.
